## Before opening

This project is a reference implementation maintained solo. Most pull
requests will be closed without merge. This is not personal. Forks are
the recommended path for outside contributors. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

If you still want to open a PR, please:

1. Open a Discussion first to gauge maintainer interest.
2. Keep changes small and focused.
3. Include tests for any non-trivial change.
4. Follow the code style in the existing surrounding code.
